content: Human-labeling session — tech-production-planning:hard seed 1. Objective: Mid-game start: yard, power, refinery, barracks and three rifles already on the field — an infantry commit. Three enemy heavy tanks sit passive in the eastern fog. Scout, recognise that infantry can't trade with armour, and pivot production to FIVE rocket soldiers. Overproducing infantry past ten exhausts the budget. Within about 91 turns.
